equations.subject: BCS301
equations.name: Stationary Distribution Condition
equations.variables: pi: stationary probability vector, P: transition matrix

equations.subject: BCS302
equations.name: Pipelining Speedup Ratio
equations.variables: n: number of instructions, k: pipeline stages, t_n: non-pipelined clock, t_k: pipelined clock

equations.subject: BCS303
equations.name: Effective Memory Access Time (EAT)
equations.variables: p: page fault rate, m: memory access time, S: fault service time

equations.subject: BCS401
equations.name: Master Theorem for Divide-and-Conquer Recurrences
equations.latex: T(n) = a T(n/b) + f(n), \quad c = \log_b a
equations.plain_text: T(n) = a * T(n/b) + f(n), where c = log_b(a)
equations.variables: a >= 1: subproblems, b > 1: factor of division, f(n): combination cost

equations.subject: BCS402
equations.name: Timer 1 Baud Rate in Mode 2
equations.variables: Fosc: crystal frequency (11.0592 MHz), SMOD: doubler bit, TH1: reload value

equations.subject: BCS403
equations.name: Relational Division Operator
equations.latex: R \div S = \pi_{R - S}(R) - \pi_{R - S}((\pi_{R - S}(R) \times S) - R)
equations.plain_text: R / S = pi_{R-S}(R) - pi_{R-S}((pi_{R-S}(R) x S) - R)

equations.subject: BCS502
equations.name: Shannon Channel Capacity Formula
equations.variables: C: capacity (bps), B: bandwidth (Hz), SNR: signal to noise ratio

equations.subject: BCS502
equations.name: Nyquist Bit Rate Formula for Noiseless Channels
equations.variables: B: bandwidth in Hz, L: number of discrete signal levels

equations.subject: BCS503
equations.name: Pumping Lemma Condition for Regular Languages
equations.latex: w = xyz, \quad |y| \ge 1, \quad |xy| \le p, \quad \forall i \ge 0: x y^i z \in L
equations.plain_text: w = xyz, |y| >= 1, |xy| <= p, for all i >= 0: x*(y^i)*z in L
equations.variables: p: pumping length, w: string in L with |w| >= p
equations.source: Hopcroft Ullman Automata Theory / BCS503 Module 2

equations.subject: BCS602
equations.name: Mean Squared Error (MSE) Loss Function
equations.variables: m: training samples, f(x): predicted hypothesis, y: true label
equations.source: Tom Mitchell / Bishop PRML / BCS602 Module 1

equations.subject: BCS602
equations.name: Information Entropy & Gain
equations.plain_text: H(S) = -sum(p_i * log2(p_i)), Gain(S, A) = H(S) - sum((|Sv|/|S|) * H(Sv))
equations.variables: S: sample set, p_i: proportion of class i, A: attribute
equations.source: Tom Mitchell Machine Learning / BCS602 Module 2

equations.subject: BCS702
equations.name: Convolutional Layer Output Spatial Dimension
equations.variables: W: input dimension, F: filter kernel size, P: padding, S: stride

equations.subject: BCS703
equations.name: RSA Encryption and Decryption
equations.plain_text: C = (M^e) mod n, M = (C^d) mod n, where e*d = 1 mod phi(n)
equations.variables: n = p*q, phi(n) = (p-1)*(q-1), e: public key, d: private key
equations.source: Stallings Cryptography & Network Security / BCS703 Module 2
